'''Neb Creip''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Creip was an ally of fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="SWVE" /> and was one of the many thousands of mourners to attend her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] in<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[city]] [[Theed]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]<ref name="SWVE" /> shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Dates">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Creip walked with a group of other senators behind Amidala's coffin as part of the funeral procession<ref name="ROTS" /> while wearing a set of [[Color|brown]], black, and [[bronze]]-colored [[Clothing|robes]] and a black [[hat]]. The senator had dark skin, brown [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neb Creip first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The funeral scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWVE" /> The [[Neb Creip/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was used in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', which was written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="Costumes">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/mxQvt|archivedate=2022-04-24}}</ref>
